title: ₹980 dispute, ₹2.51 crore frozen
summary: A ₹980 UPI spend by a mule froze a liquor merchant's entire ₹2.51 crore balance; LienLine liens ₹980 and releases the rest.

title: ₹18.4 lakh 'digital arrest', 8 accounts frozen
summary: A retired professor's ₹18.4 lakh fans out across 4 banks in 40 minutes; LienLine liens each account's traceable share and releases a freelancer paid for real work.

title: One distributor, four tracing rules, four answers
summary: ₹4.5 lakh of fraud money mixes into a pharma distributor's busy account; FIFO, LIFO, pro-rata and LIBR disagree, and LienLine shows the range and why LIBR is used.

title: A mule on 7 complaints: full freeze, justified
summary: A 74-day-old current account on the suspect registry, linked to 7 complaints, passes 98% of its money through; LienLine justifies a full freeze and still liens a kirana store only ₹640.
